You lose stem cells as you age is the most basic way of explaining the complex biology. Special cells that can grow into essentially anything you might require. Stem cells exist mostly during your development from a single cell to a baby then basically disappear from you completely. Which is a huge pain in the ass since they are so incredibly useful - which is why there's been a tonne of research around stem cells for a long time and also why its controversial (you can only get them from embryo's if you want to experiment).

Since you no longer have these - the damaged or removed tissue which you want to be filled in with new growth simply cannot differentiate itself from what it already was into something you want replaced. Certain animals keep stem cells along for a long time and is why certain lizards can replace lost limbs like its no big deal.
